name: Red Pine Campground
note: Formerly Ogston's RV Park; RV park set around several fishing ponds off US 53 northwest of Duluth, with free paddleboats and canoes. Pond-side: sites 82-89 back onto a bay of the pond; the other loops sit across park roads or tree lines from the water. No tents and no sleeping in vehicles on sites. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: redpinecampground.com read 2026-11-12: 100 full-hookup sites 1-99 plus 10 water/electric sites 101-110, pull-through and back-in, big rigs welcome (a few sites slightly under 50 ft); nightly and weekly stays booked online through Premier Campground (2027 bookings open Jan 1), only 'a limited number of monthly and seasonal sites' and 'no seasonal sites available for the 2027 season'; nightly $48-55 + tax + reservation fee, so the cheapest site is under the US$50 gate (no gateway within 40 km, gateways.py); Google Maps 4.7 over 231 reviews with phone, RV Life 4.5* $$$ (avg $41) over 177 ratings; not the same place as 14622 Saginaw Campground (7 km away, different operator and phone)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: operator calls the water bodies ponds ('In the ponds you'll find...'). Esri imagery (sat.py 400 m and 160 m half-width frames, rendered) at 46.8738,-92.3302: the curved row of sites on the west side of the central pond's bay (operator site map: sites 82-89, road behind them, pond in front) sits about 20-30 m from the shoreline across open mown grass with scattered trees, kayaks on the bank; nothing between but open ground. The main loops (sites 1-61, 62-81, 90-99) are separated from the ponds by park roads, a day-use beach/fire-ring lawn or tree-lined banks, and 101-110 are in the woods. Pond value earned by the 82-89 row only; caveat in the note.

fees.note: $300 a week; tax and a per-reservation fee extra (amount not posted); electric metered on stays of 30 days or more.

flags: RV Life rates it $$$ (avg $41); the operator's posted nightly range $48-55 is under the $50 gate at its low end, but the per-reservation fee is not posted and the high end is over $50
Pond value rests on one row of 8 sites (82-89) on the central pond's bay; the rest of the park is across roads/tree lines from the water
Good Sam directory: not a Good Sam Park (gs false), military discount true
